method: Source UI with synthetic transport only; no real Auth, SQL, Storage HTTP, operational persistence or physical device proof

checks.name: creation validates fields, focuses the first error and restores the trigger
dirty creation keeps local data until explicit discard
failed save keeps the completed form and the error is recoverable
creation preserves the declared initial scope in the returned revision
focus refetch cannot advance the form expected_version
return, resubmit, approve and new revision preserve the submitted history
method publication keeps the study fixed to its original version
action starts blank and opens the canonical task with only released instructions
file query revocation hides cached original and upload controls
an open draft survives a network error and is removed when source access is denied
write denial hides the cached study before the next permission poll and recovers by authorized read
comparison denial removes the private editor while a network failure preserves it
pending upload can fail, be cancelled and retried as a fresh intent
empty, query failure and revoked source are distinct states
